Mode.Name: Mobile Mode
Mode.Hint: How Velvet Mobile decides whether to activate on this device. Auto detects phones and tablets; Phone/Tablet force it on (useful for testing on desktop); Off disables the module entirely on this client.

Map.Name: Show map
Map.Hint: Keeps the game canvas visible behind the mobile interface, with touch navigation (drag to pan, pinch to zoom). Turn it off to free memory and battery on phones: the map is then never loaded at all. Changing this requires a reload.

UiScale.Name: UI Scale
UiScale.Hint: Global scale factor for Velvet Mobile interface elements. Increase for easier reading and larger touch targets.

ChatOnMessage.Name: Open chat on new messages
ChatOnMessage.Hint: Which incoming messages open the chat panel automatically. Everything else just lights the chat button indicator.

ChatAutoHide.Name: Auto-hide chat (seconds)
ChatAutoHide.Hint: Seconds until an auto-opened chat panel hides itself. 0 keeps it open. Touching the panel cancels the timer.

Debug.Name: Debug Mode
Debug.Hint: Enable verbose console logging for troubleshooting.

License.Name: Patreon licence
License.Label: Manage licence
License.Hint: Connect your Patreon account to activate Velvet Mobile in this world, or release the installation slot to use it elsewhere. GM only.

License.Title: Activation
License.Intro: Connect your Patreon account to activate Velvet Mobile in this world.
License.GmOnly: Only the GM authorises. Once activated, every player gets the mobile interface automatically.
License.Cancelled: Authorisation cancelled. If the popup never opened, use "I have a code".
License.Locked: Licence server unreachable. The module is locked until it reconnects.
License.CodeHint: Paste the code shown after connecting your Patreon account.
License.StatusInactive: No active licence in this world.
License.ReleaseHint: Release the slot if you are moving your subscription to another server or browser.
License.ReleaseConfirm: Release this installation? Velvet Mobile will switch off for every player until you connect again.

Shell.NoToken: You have no token on the active scene to move.
Shell.NoTargets: No tokens to target on this scene.
Shell.SwipeHint: Swipe up or tap your portrait
Shell.NoActorHint: Ask your GM to assign a character to your user, or grant you ownership of one with a token in the scene.
Shell.NoActorGMHint: Assign yourself a character in the user configuration, or activate a scene with tokens. To leave mobile mode: settings button → Mobile Mode → Off.
